# Zero Engine: test build (Windows x64)

Built from this commit; rebuilt and recommitted when the owner asks for a new test build.

## Cubase (VST3)

1. Close Cubase.
2. Copy the whole `Zero Engine.vst3` folder into `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\`.
3. Open Cubase. If it doesn't appear, Studio > VST Plug-in Manager > Rescan.

## Standalone

Run `Zero Engine.exe`. Pick the audio device under Options > Audio/MIDI Settings.

Favourites are stored per machine in `%APPDATA%\Zero Engine\Favourites`.
